title: UMAS3D: Unified Mask-Free 3D Editing with Region-Adaptive Source Preservation
abstract: 3D editing aims to modify an existing 3D asset according to user intent while preserving geometry and appearance outside the intended edit region. Existing methods often rely on task-specific training, source-3D inversion, or external 3D masks, and lack a unified framework for diverse editing conditions and tasks. We propose UMAS3D, a unified 3D editing framework that is training-free, inversion-free, and free from external 3D masks. UMAS3D converts text, bounding boxes, reference images, and their combinations into common target-view guidance, after which addition, deletion, modification, appearance, and pose editing share the same downstream 3D generation process. Our key insight is to couple online edit-region estimation with region-aware source preservation. Mask-Free Adaptive Region Modeling (MARM) initializes an Edit/Keep prior from source-target visual differences and progressively refines it as the target structure evolves, while Source-Guided Preservation Steering (SGPS) constrains the current Keep-region states to retain source geometry and appearance without suppressing target-driven changes. Experiments show that UMAS3D supports addition, deletion, modification, appearance, and pose editing while effectively preserving unedited source content. These advances make UMAS3D a unified framework for flexible and source-preserving 3D editing across diverse editing conditions.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.15533v1 的 27 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：not-found。
analysis.ideaZh: UMAS3D 在 frozen TRELLIS 上把多模态编辑统一为 target image，再由在线 Edit/Keep region refinement 与 structure/SLAT 双空间 source steering 保留非编辑内容；有实际可借鉴的局部资产编辑机制。作者报告 preservation 明显改善，但定量实验使用 GT target view，不能直接视为完整自然语言编辑链路的表现。
analysis.motivationZh: 如何在无外部3D mask、无inversion和无额外训练时编辑3D资产，同时保留无关几何与外观。
analysis.methodZh: MARM以DINOv2对应、外观与边缘变化建立2D证据，在多视角source voxel上聚类为3D regions，并按occupancy deviation的EMA/peer比较调整Edit/Keep。SGPS在Keep区对source occupancy和SLAT做clean-state校正与sample-level优化；五类任务共用流程。
methodFlow: Source asset四视角与text/box/reference转为target-view guidance
DINOv2差异与多视角voxel regions初始化Edit/Keep
Stage 1每5步结合occupancy EMA更新region并保持source structure
Stage 2固定partition，在Keep SLAT上校正、监督与边界blend
analysis.experimentsZh: 150个Pxform/Omni3DEdit对象，五类编辑；统一GT target image的定量评估，完整multimodal链路用于定性；40人偏好实验。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告Pres-IoU 0.7217、CD-L1 0.0134；相比3DEditFormer的0.5881/0.0149，保存改善大于整体几何改善。（Table 3, p.7）；作者报告instruction/visual/source preference为57%/54%/61%。（Table 4, p.8） 对照范围：比较EditP23、Easy3E、VoxHammer、Nano3D、Vinedresser3D、3DEditFormer；统一target image提高3D阶段公平性，但不衡量完整指令处理。 消融与诊断：Table 5逐步引入structure、SLAT、adaptive region与mask-free；支持互补作用，但部分指标并非每一步单调改善。
analysis.insightZh: 贡献在同一generation trajectory内把自适应3D edit localization与source-state preservation耦合，超出单纯换backbone；mask-free指无需外部3D mask，并非没有内部二值区域。
analysis.evidenceZh: MARM由多视角source features构造完整3D regions，按持续deviation重新分配Edit/Keep。（Sec.3.4, Eq.3–10, pp.5–6）；SGPS只优化当前生成state，分structure occupancy与SLAT Keep tokens保持source。（Sec.3.5, Eq.11–15, p.6; Fig.2, p.4）；作者报告150对象Pres-IoU 0.7217、Pres-PSNR 24.9473，优于所列六个baseline。（Table 3, p.7）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接服务可编辑3D assets和局部source preservation，值得细读region modeling与state steering。
analysis.caveatZh: 多模态条件冲突没有显式优先级处理，文本与reference不一致可能失败。；quantitative使用GT target view，不能将数据提升直接外推到任意文本/参考输入。；source region只有8个、自适应由occupancy驱动，细粒度外观编辑与隐藏面保留边界仍需更广测试。；作者报告约245.8秒/asset，不含image generation与部分预处理。
